name: Nano Banana
tagline: Nano Banana is an intelligent image generation and editing platform based on Google's latest AI technology
description: Nano Banana is an intelligent image generation and editing platform based on Google's latest AI technology. Nano Banana offers revolutionary features like character consistency, natural language editing, and multi-image fusion. Whether it's changing outfits, transforming scenes, or precise local editing, Nano Banana retains original characteristics, unlocking limitless creative possibilities.
